text:
rachel: quick summary from support: multiple customers tripped on key shadowing during a large rotation. they had REDWOOD_API_KEY + REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY set and some background services kept using the org key. support queue spiked.

tom: ouch. do we have an audit tool to find who has both envs set in infra?

priya: I started a small script `rw keys audit` that scans k8s manifests / env files and prints occurrences. sample output: 
```
service/auth-worker: REDWOOD_API_KEY=org_live_xxx, REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj_live_yyy
service/web-frontend: REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY only
```
I can open-source it in the repo as a CLI helper.

carl: love that. next question: what's the safest roll-out to avoid breaking customers?

rachel: proposal: three-step plan:
1) emit startup warnings + telemetry `credential.shadow_detected` whenever both keys present. no behavior change.
2) ship `REDWOOD_PREFER_PROJECT=true` opt-in across SDKs and add `rw keys migrate --apply-pref` to set that in env manifests automatically.
3) provide per-service bindings (REDWOOD_BINDING_<SERVICE>) and a console migration UI to bind routes to project keys. flip default after 6 weeks if telemetry looks healthy.

priya: implementation note: SDKs should check in this order when serviceName not provided: REDWOOD_BINDING_<SERVICE> (if RW_SERVICE set) -> prefer flag -> project key -> org key. For explicit client config (serviceName) prefer binding first.

tom: for services that can't be changed quickly, we should add a SIGHUP handler example for flushing in-memory creds so ops can rotate without full restarts. small sample for Node: 
```
process.on('SIGHUP', () => { credentialCache.clear(); console.warn('Credential cache flushed'); });
```
We'll add equivalents for Go/Rust/Python.

carl: telemetry plan? we need numbers before flipping default.

rachel: telemetry events: `credential.shadow_detected` (counts), `credential.prefer_opt_in` (when REDWOOD_PREFER_PROJECT used), `credential.binding_used`, `credential.rotate_reconnect` (when reconnect succeeds with new key). Tag with sdk, region, and service if available.

ops-bot: Created issue devex/sdk-credentials#4490: "Keys migration: audit CLI, PREF_PROJECT opt-in, bindings, SIGHUP flush examples, telemetry" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/4490)

priya: quick note on sampleapps: I'll update all sampleapps to prefer project when REDWOOD_PREFER_PROJECT=true and to print which key they used at startup. that should reduce noisy tickets.

tom: docs + support playbook: add a troubleshooting checklist that support can use: 1) run `rw keys audit`; 2) check startup log for "Using REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY" vs org; 3) set REDWOOD_PREFER_PROJECT=true and restart / SIGHUP; 4) if impossible, bind route in console. Add canned responses.

carl: what about streaming reconnects? tests need to simulate rotation mid-stream and ensure reconnect picks up the new credential when prefer flag or binding is used.

priya: will add an e2e `streams/rotation.spec` that runs an in-memory stream, rotates project key, and asserts reconnect identity. will run in CI opt-in mode (REDWOOD_PREFER_PROJECT=true) until default flip.

rachel: timeline suggestion: warnings + audit CLI + sampleapp logging this week; opt-in env var and SDK patch next week; bindings + console UI over 3 weeks; flip default after 6 weeks if telemetry green.

tom: +1. assign owners: priya -> audit CLI + sampleapps + e2e, carl -> SIGHUP examples + SDK helper, rachel -> comms + support playbook, tom -> telemetry events + dashboards.

ops-bot: Scheduled epic devex/credentials-migration and assigned tasks.

priya: one small UX idea: console show "migration risk" per route that flags routes with shadowing keys. customers can click "auto-bind" to convert selected routes to project keys (console will call the `rw keys migrate` CLI under the hood for supported infra).

carl: please include a rollback plan: we must be able to revert to org-first for any customer if something breaks. keep REDWOOD_PREFER_PROJECT toggle available for at least 3 months after flip.

rachel: agreed. include rollback steps in playbook and a support escalation path to platform. I'll draft the playbook now and post to #product when ready.

priya: starting the audit run now across a few customers (sanitized). will post aggregated counts here in a few hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
